versions.changelog:
Initial release of the photo-to-disco-elysium skill:

- Upload portraits or environment photos to transform them into Disco Elysium-inspired psychological paintings or concept art.
- First turn explains aesthetic suitability and requests user confirmation before generating any images.
- For portraits, users choose between a bold conceptual style (default) or a restrained, character-focused style.
- For environments, essential landmarks are preserved and reimagined; pure natural scenes are supported with caution.
- No use of game characters, UI, or assets—only the visual style is referenced.
